content:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty PD12345 fired — severity: critical. Alert: GPU memory pressure + CUDA_ALLOC_FAIL on pool 'pool-gamma-usw2' (node gpu-03). Sample: "RuntimeError: CUDA out of memory when allocating 1.2 GiB". Auto-retry threshold hit.

Alice Chen: acked PD12345 :white_check_mark: I'm oncall. Starting triage — pulling last 10m of kube logs and NVML metrics.

Bob Patel: any customer-facing errors yet? seeing spikes in retries in the metrics dashboard.

Jordan (SRE): looking at evictions & KV cache stats — big prefetch burst at 2024-11-07T16:01:xxZ. KV cache evictions jumped ~3x, swap usage creeping up on gpu-03. Likely runaway prefetch combined with a larger batch of long-seq requests.

Lin Park: grabbing node logs now. quick grep:
```
$ kubectl logs pod/llm-worker-abc -n inference | tail -n 50
2024-11-07T16:02:11Z ERROR runtime: CUDA out of memory trying to allocate 1280 MiB
2024-11-07T16:02:11Z WARN kvcache: evicting 1024 entries
2024-11-07T16:02:12Z ERROR model-serving: allocation failed, falling back
```

Maya (CS): AcmeCorp reported increased 503s about 30s ago. They flagged a user-impacting error in their dashboard. I'm adding a note to PD ticket and sending a proactive message.

Alice Chen: ok mitigation plan — 1) disable kv-prefetch on pool-gamma, 2) throttle incoming long-seq routes to that pool, 3) if continues, drain node gpu-03 and restart. Can someone run the config patch?

infra-ops: patch ready, applying to pool-gamma:
```yaml
apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
metadata:
  name: inference-pool-gamma-config
data:
  kv_prefetch_enabled: "false"
  max_sequence_length: "2048"
  prefetch_rate_limit: "0.2"
```
Applying...
```
$ kubectl apply -f pool-gamma-patch.yaml -n infra
configmap/inference-pool-gamma-config configured
```

deploy-bot: rollout started for config map inference-pool-gamma-config (pool-gamma). 3/3 replicas updated.

Jordan (SRE): monitoring metrics — evictions dropping, memory pressure decreasing on gpu-03. Still seeing a few allocation failures but rate down from 200/min -> 12/min.

Lin Park: executed graceful drain on gpu-03 for pods flagged high-memory:
```
$ ./opsctl drain-node --node gpu-03 --selector memory-hog=true --grace 30s
Draining 4 pods... evicted 4/4
```
Restarting the worker process on gpu-03 to reclaim leaked allocations.

Alice Chen: PD acknowledged by me. Escalating to L2 just in case — @Bob Patel you're L2? please standby.

Bob Patel: on it. I'm preparing a fallback route: re-route heavy long-seq traffic to model-variant "llm-medium-quant" which uses less VRAM. Patch ready, will switch if OOMs persist.

Maya (CS): updated AcmeCorp: "We're investigating a GPU memory issue affecting inference in US-WEST; mitigation in progress. We'll follow up with ETA for full restoration." They want updates every 15m.

Jordan (SRE): alerting note — discovered root cause candidate: aggressive KV prefetch misconfigured for some workloads leading to memory fragmentation + partial leaks when combined with async prefetch. Need postmortem.

Lin Park: worker restarted on gpu-03. GPU memory free back to normal baseline. No further CUDA_ALLOC_FAIL in last 90s.

infra-ops: prefetch disabled cluster-side for pool-gamma and reduced prefetch_rate_limit across all similar pools to 0.2 temporarily. Will revert only after postmortem and controlled rollout.

Alice Chen: customer impact confirmed: partial 503s for AcmeCorp (approx 18 min window). PD ticket annotated with impact and mitigation timeline. Marking incident as handled for now; keeping channel open for 30m to watch for regressions.

Bob Patel: +1. Scheduled a canary rollout for restored config later today with traffic shaping. Also adding a temporary autoscale throttle to prevent simultaneous heavy prefetch on multiple nodes.

incident-bot: PD12345 status changed: acknowledged by Alice Chen at 1758675335, resolved by Alice Chen at 1758675588 (manual resolution).

Alice Chen: closing PD for now — will draft an RCA and link to this thread. Thanks everyone for quick responses. :pray: Please file follow-up tasks: 1) postmortem, 2) telemetry alert tuning for prefetch bursts, 3) config guardrail to prevent prefetch > 0.5 without approval.

Lin Park: created follow-up ticket INF-4021 for postmortem and INF-4022 to add config guardrails.

Bob Patel: monitoring looks stable. I'll keep an eye for the next hour.

Maya (CS): I'll send a final follow-up to AcmeCorp once we confirm 1h stable.

Alice Chen: thanks team. moving to watch mode. :eyes:
